<noinclude>
Some notes on this bar:
* "Up-to-date" includes all articles without the version tag, which could still have some missing info. Might be worth tracking those separately.
* The numbers aren't exact, since the categories may include a few irrelevant pages outside the main namespace (sandboxes, talk pages).


</noinclude>{{

#vardefine: totalCurrentArticles | 
      {{#expr: {{formatnum:{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}|R}} 
             - {{formatnum:{{PAGESINCATEGORY:Obsolete}}|R}} 
             - {{formatnum:{{PAGESINCATEGORY:Obsolete features}}|R}}
      }}
}}{{
#vardefine: articlesNeedingReview | {{formatnum:{{PAGESINCATEGORY:Migrated pages needing review}}|R}}
}}{{
#vardefine: sectionsNeedingReview | {{formatnum:{{PAGESINCATEGORY:Migrated pages with sections needing review}}|R}}
}}{{
#vardefine: upToDateArticles | 
  {{#expr: 
    {{#var:totalCurrentArticles}} 
    - {{#var:articlesNeedingReview}}
    - {{#var:sectionsNeedingReview}}
  }}
}}{{
Template:3-way progress bar|{{#var:upToDateArticles}}|{{#var:sectionsNeedingReview}}|{{#var:articlesNeedingReview}}
|text=[[Dwarf_Fortress_Wiki:Version_migration|'''{{#var:upToDateArticles}} articles up-to-date for v50; {{#var:sectionsNeedingReview}} partially migrated; {{#var:articlesNeedingReview}} remaining''']]
}}
